text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Sprinters Stakes, the<n>second G1 sprint
race on our list.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This race is only 1,200 meters, just<n>short of a mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Meanin' I can throw caution to the<n>wind and gun it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the steep hill right<n>before the
Nakayama Racecourse's<n>finish line calls for a lot of
power.<n>Which means...
choice_data_list: This is the perfect race to show off your skills!
This is the perfect race to show off your skills!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to power and speed,<n>I'm the best
around! I'll prove it to<n>ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So you'd better start plannin' for a<n>party, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Go out there and win it!
Go out there and win it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll be back in a jiff!
